source_observations.observation: Current S03 consumes/drops original scalar into normalized k256 SigningKey and production attempt returns SigningUnavailable. Q01 does not claim otherwise: it assigns original-nsec preservation to K01 and actual device custody to Q02/Q03. No current usable signing/recovery workflow is inferred.

Legacy text/CompactSeedQR import code is a cited historical adapter, not proof of required native nsec admission. Q01 expressly refuses inherited formats and automatic operation/recovery mode switching.

Existing scan limits can be None, animated frames use old capacities, and JPEG capture uses Python BytesIO. Hard-coded pins/default resolution and adapters prove neither bounded native decoder work/persistence nor an identified kit. Q01 requires measured finite pre-decoder/image/copy cleanup limits, treating these as candidates rather than qualification.
